title: Validation failures return 422, REQUIREMENTS.R9 how_to_verify expects 400
evidence: src/app.py:57 _validated_body sends HTTPStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT (422) for validate_book errors; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 says 'rejected (400)'. Malformed JSON does return 400 (src/app.py:44).
suggestion: 422 is a defensible REST convention for semantic validation errors and R8 allows appropriate 4xx codes; align to 400 only if strict spec-literal matching is required.

title: Validation and robustness beyond spec
evidence: src/validation.py:24-36 validates year range and ISBN length; src/app.py:37 caps body at 1 MiB; src/db.py:23 lock makes the SQLite repo thread-safe under ThreadingHTTPServer.
